violation_type.title: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over (26 TAC §744.2601(9))
violation_type.short_title: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over
violation_type.typical_finding: Two televisions were observed in the rooms and were not mounted.

finding_variants.text: Two televisions were observed in the rooms and were not mounted.
This standard was reviewed on 6/4/2026 as a follow-up to a previous inspection and found deficient. A television was not anchored in one classroom used by children.

A tv that was sitting on a child size table in the main play space was not anchored to the table or the wall. Note: this was corrected at inspection when the director removed it and placed in the director office.
A television was observed on a cart. The television was not secured to the cart.    Note: The television was removed from licensed space.
A television was not anchored in one classroom used by children.
